Risk level R encodes uncertainty through entropy-based volatility metrics, while freshness F ensures temporal relevance. Movement badge M captures discrete shifts in player state. Together, they form a triadic kernel for Bayesian updating in GSE’s state transition logic. Each primitive operates under well-defined assumptions: risk is tied to variance, freshness to recency, and movement to change magnitude. Failure modes occur when R diverges due to data staleness, F exceeds acceptable thresholds, or M misrepresents actual change. These primitives enable GSE to maintain a dynamic, risk-aware model of player evolution.
